2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: New York’s veteran quarterback meets Tennessee’s developing defense
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: The Jets open with Geno Smith back under center and Breece Hall expected to be available, giving New York a veteran quarterback and proven backfield combination. Tennessee begins the Robert Saleh era with Cam Ward coming off a promising finish to his rookie season and Tony Pollard still central to the offense. The Titans need protection and manageable down-and-distance to keep New York’s rush from dictating the game. The Jets, meanwhile, must avoid the turnover drought that defined last season and turn pressure into shorter fields for their offense.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: New York can control the game through its veteran backfield and pressure plan, while Tennessee needs Ward to stay protected and avoid long-yardage situations that expose the offense.
